pages.title: Diagoldze — Golden Curse
pages.text: $(o)Gold creeps over and restrains a target.$()

Manga spoiler: Macht's curse that turns things to gold. Here a 10-second golden restraint rather than permanent transmutation. One legendary level. Deals no damage; holds the target, turning to gold, for 10 seconds.

pages.title: At a glance
pages.text: $(l)School:$() Evocation$(br)$(l)Rarity:$() Legendary and up$(br)$(l)Levels:$() 1$(br)$(l)Mana:$() 350$(br)$(l)Cooldown:$() 60 s$(br)$(l)Cast:$() Long, 5 s$(br)$(l)Effect:$() No damage; a 10 s golden restraint
